props.name: icon
props.description: When set to an icon name an icon is displayed next to the label.

props.name: iconLibrary
props.description: The icon library to use when rendering an icon. If not set, the default icon library will be used.

props.name: label
props.description:
By default the label is visually hidden. When this prop is enabled the
label is rendered visually as well.

events.name: click
events.description: Emitted when the button is pressed.
